findings.summary: The .at policy is registered under the key "AT", but policy_for looks up tld.lower(), so the entry can never match: .at keeps DEFAULT (3 attempts, RATE_LIMITED retried). The PR's tests read POLICIES["AT"] directly and never go through policy_for.
findings.evidence: With the patch applied, policy_for('at').max_attempts == 3 and a RATE_LIMITED reply to an .at command is retried; see review/tests/test_at_policy.py, which fails on the patched code.

tests_run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . (patch applied): PR tests pass
review/tests/test_at_policy.py against the patched code: 2 failures
